title: Deep Learning for Bias Detection: From Inception to Deployment

bias_targets.methodology: Training and evaluating a transfer learning-based text classifier (LSTM-LM) on a manually annotated dataset of enterprise content (iShield.ai dataset) and the Sexist Statement in Workplace (SSW) dataset.
Training and evaluating a transfer learning-based text classifier (LSTM-LM) on a manually annotated dataset of enterprise content to detect text that singles out a particular race.
Training and evaluating a transfer learning-based text classifier (LSTM-LM) on a manually annotated dataset of enterprise content to detect text that singles out a particular age bracket.
